reviews.classification: cumulative north-star through5280; source-correction/coverage discrepancy and actual held-system direction versus proposals
reviews.disposition:
Continuation of B447: freshly read original4,281–5,280 in five contiguous200-line outputs; cumulative original coverage is1–5,280. The earlier7,761-line prefix was rechecked byte-identical at continuation start. Remainder5,281–7,761 and appended reconciliation notices stay open. This range completes the Primordial Saint Sect scout/targeted audit, open continuity threads, held-system source search/deep-dive and user answers, system-evolution/synopsis survey, seven Steam-wave summaries, and older UI/browser/gimmick/AU discussions. It does not read their linked private or research bodies by proxy.

**Specific coverage discrepancy retained.** The targeted-audit paragraph says “about120 chapters”, but its14 listed inclusive, nonoverlapping intervals contain197 chapter numbers. [Task-local arithmetic](audits/reconciliation-2026-11-04/northstar-range-arithmetic-b448.json) verifies that list calculation only. Keep the prose estimate and listed windows as conflicting historical coverage evidence until the actual audit receipts/source inputs reconcile them; do not replace the estimate with a claim that197 chapters were actually read. The scout is explicitly superseded on ending, page accounting, first harvest, fusion-floor certainty, realm description and restart detection. Preserve those corrections without promoting the targeted sample, MTL terms or later proposed reincarnation/talent rules into a complete source audit. The listed unreviewed windows still matter.

**A search lead is not the final answer.** The early “possible source” and unsuccessful re-audit of the held-system book are followed by the user's confirmation of Virtuous Demon and a bounded98-chapter deep-dive claim. The identification question is therefore closed in this history; do not ask the user to reconfirm the rejected title or silently apply its synopsis. The confirmed title and dossier claim do not freshly qualify its every mechanism or current availability. Keep holder, host, target, sealer, passenger, observer, thief and system-entity roles distinct: one person may hold several, and a source grants only the actual relationship/channel, not every proposed watch/drain/force/edit capability.

**Later user answers qualify the initial recovery/visibility proposal.** The explicit answer says threat/hostility is visible only as far as the character can know, and a system entity can be playable where supported. This supersedes the earlier mandatory visible steer/autonomy meter, eventual legibility and compulsory recovered path. Actual hidden intent can remain unknown, including after loss/death, without displaying sealed truth in a recap. “Every hold has an exit”, always opening a replacement path, every look leaving a trace and skills never replacing clue play are proposals, not universal safeguards. A relevant identification/divination/other faculty may directly supply knowledge within its scope. Current [direction](USER_VISION.md), [cheat library](CHEAT_LIBRARY.md) and [observer-aware UI rules](UI_RULES.md) govern selected implementation. A storyteller may pace eligible events; it cannot retrofit a hostile owner or a puppet action merely to create a twist without a real world mechanism and state cause. Reversed events affect titles/rewards only under their actual continuing or settlement contract.

**Evolution is a multidimensional palette.** Reach, interface, mind, allegiance, fit, integrity, user scope, known origin, cost and form can change independently; up/sideways/inward/outward/down/apart/away/person are alternatives, not a mandatory climb. A larger scope need not gain universal access over a personal system. A numeric improvement is still useful where it changes play; the proposed every-step-new-verb and once-per-season cadence are not global gates. The62-work survey is expressly synopsis-only, with memory-only examples and no review evidence; it does not prove complete runtime lifecycles or that a system must become sentient, charge fees or impose drawbacks.

**Comparator differences are useful, not defects in our design.** The Steam-wave summaries preserve different inheritance, world/person reset, progress/pressure clocks, authored immortal continuity, hybrid-body needs, autonomy and failure-aftermath choices. The Sunless code/developer-description and Disco timing discrepancies stay unresolved in their actual sources. Early2025 complaint summaries are dated reception claims, not current usability tests or mandatory difficulty policy. A full robot and a food-dependent synthetic body can both exist. The Vagrus “still running” line is historical, not a live handle. These summaries do not certify the linked reports or renew an extraction/research assignment.

The older browser recommendation is qualified by current [architecture](ARCHITECTURE_RULES.md) and [PROJECT](../PROJECT.md), including Electron plus web direction. A wrapper does not by itself prove unlimited storage, file-save migration, Steam delivery or installed behavior. The gimmick checklist helps deepen a chosen idea; it does not require every minor detail to gain eight new systems. Bloodline purity/dilution/intimidation, parent-specific inheritance, mutation and automatic reactions are local proposals, not universal genetics or forced balance. AU cards preserve their chosen source/era and actual deltas without assuming every variant is cheap or publicly shippable. No fresh legal/source/license determination, PDF read, gameplay/code edit, live process, personal save or test/build/browser was performed. Continue actual reading at5,281.
